title: 12web3
tagline: We are a learning tool for web3 focused on young college students in search of their professional projection, using an easy and practical language so that anyone who is not familiar with the blockchain can learn and thus reduce the knowledge gap for the adoption of blockchain.

prizes.placement: 🗃 Coinbase — 🥈 Best Integration of Coinbase Wallet
prizes.title: Coinbase Cloud

description:
Colombia has a big problem, the young people which end the high school has are uncertain about their future and career opportunities. At the same time, the web3 ecosystem has few proffesionals and 
increasingly the actual world needs a public goods improvement. 12web3, educates and conects the talent whit the ecosystem 
through a descentralized way that brings opportunities and benefits to all parties.
how_its_made:
This project is developed with Next js for the frontend, livepeer.studio was used to host and process the videos. And authentication is handled with Moralis and Rainbow Kit. The project is deployed on vercel. 
The platform is developed to allow users to learn through short videos
